record_type_quote:
This replication tests the claim from Hurst & Kavanagh (2017) that individuals with faster
life strategies (measured with the Mini-K) report more symptoms of psychopathology
(measured using the DSM-5 Self-Rated Level 1 Cross-Cutting Symptom Measure-Adult).
